d: Long, sleek jet black hair with a side-part and straight bangs frames a mature, adult face with sharp, narrow crimson eyes. The slim build is dressed in a white and navy blue military-style dress with a high slit, featuring gold buttons and a red necktie, layered under a long white overcoat with a navy blue lining, gold braided aiguillettes, and black belted straps. Signature details include a silver sword hilt tucked at the waist, hanging earrings, and dark navy pumps.
